crossRefs.note: He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.

translations.web: He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.
translations.bsb: But he went only as far as the king’s gate, because the law prohibited anyone wearing sackcloth from entering that gate.
translations.kjv: And came even before the king's gate: for none might enter into the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.
translations.asv: and he came even before the king's gate: for none might enter within the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.
